content: Claude vision coordinates are absolute pixels in the post-resize image. Standard tier 1568px/1568 tokens; high-res (4.7+) 2576px/4784 tokens; tokens=ceil(w/28)*ceil(h/28). Pre-resize with reference resizedSize() or rescale by resized (not padded) dims; transformations.oversized_image='error' prevents silent resize. Ask for [x1,y1,x2,y2] pixels, not normalized.
